# AU 2026: The Design & Make Conference


Join Autodesk Research in Las Vegas this September


Share page Link copied[Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.research.autodesk.com%2Fblog%2Fau-2026-design-and-make-conference%2F)[X](https://x.com/intent/tweet?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.research.autodesk.com%2Fblog%2Fau-2026-design-and-make-conference%2F)[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/shareArticle?mini=true&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.research.autodesk.com%2Fblog%2Fau-2026-design-and-make-conference%2F)Copy Link


Erin Arnold


08/03/2026


[AU 2026](https://conferences.autodesk.com/flow/autodesk/au2026/web/page/overview) – taking place Sept. 15-17 in Las Vegas – brings together the Design & Make community to build skills, strengthen connections, and shape what’s next. It brings together professionals across architecture, engineering, construction, product design, manufacturing, and media and entertainment to share ideas, advance industry practices, and explore the technologies shaping what’s next.


Join thousands of industry experts for:


- **Learning Opportunities** : 500+ classes, industry talks, panels, instructional demos, and hands-on labs.
- **Autodesk Updates and News** : General Session and the industry keynotes from Autodesk executives.
- **Networking Events** : Meetups, receptions, and parties allowing you to connect with design and make professionals, leaders, students, and more.


[Register to attend in-person](https://conferences.autodesk.com/flow/autodesk/au2025/web/page/passes) or block your calendar to tune into the digital experience to watch live keynotes and other featured programming. We’ll share more in this space about the role of Autodesk Research at AU and how you can best follow along in person or from home. Stay tuned!
